message.content:
The rotational symmetry group of a cube has \(24\) rotations.

There are \(8!\) ways to place the \(8\) different-colored beads on the \(8\) vertices if the cube is fixed.

Since all beads have different colors, no nontrivial rotation can leave an arrangement unchanged: a rotation would have to move at least one vertex to a different vertex, but the colors at those two vertices are different.

Thus every arrangement has exactly \(24\) equivalent rotated versions.

\[
\frac{8!}{24}=\frac{40320}{24}=1680
\]

The answer is 1680.
